text: "An older man in a brown coat is on grass with a jumping white dog. He holds a red ball, shielding his eyes. The dog brings back a bone."
original_texts: An older man with a gray beard and hair, wearing a brown coat, stands in a grassy area facing a small white dog.
The dog playfully jumps up towards the man, wagging its tail.
The man raises his arm, holding a red ball, while the dog eagerly watches.
The man looks intently in the distance, shielding his eyes with his hand as if searching for something.
The dog returns with a bone in its mouth, standing in front of the man.
